g.text: One trip, one graph server, 120 days. All twenty figures on one frame
A ONE TRIP AS A DURABLE JOB
one conversation; when it closes, the context is gone
no process holds the job while it waits
trip.plan fans out: fares · hotels · weather
approval requested; lease closed, no process held
schedule emitter: one shared fare watch
refund above desk limit: stored wait
B TOPOLOGY no node opens a port
no graph is declared; the path is recorded
only the in-flight step runs again
CONTINUATION resumption is replay from the top
stored wait · server restarted ✓ · worker redeployed ✓
The checkpoint is what makes replay safe.
lost reply → query the original identity
E ONE WATCH, MANY TRIPS · THE FACTORY
searches a day: 4N if each trip polls, 4 if shared
AGENT FACTORY each stage a recorded step
Illustrative composition of the paper’s twenty figures; numbered events tie the trip to its mechanisms.
Timings, fares and days are illustrative. Motion traces connections; it is not live execution data.
